Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّ مُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيِّكَ
Translation: O Allah, I ask You by the right of Muhammad, Your Prophet
And Ali, Your Guardian

Arabic text: وَالشَّأْنِ وَالْقَدْرِ الَّذِيْ خَصَصْتَهُمَا بِهِ دُوْنَ خَلْقِكَ
Translation: And by the status and honor that You have exclusively given them above Your creation
To send blessings upon Muhammad and Ali

Arabic text: وَأَنْ تَبْدَأَ بِهِمَا فِيْ كُلِّ خَيْرٍ عَاجِلٍ
Translation: And to begin with them in every immediate good

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
The guiding Imams
The calling masters
The brilliant stars
The radiant symbols
The caretakers of the servants
The pillars of the lands
The sent she-camel
The saving ark
Sailing through the overwhelming depths

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
The treasurers of Your knowledge
The pillars of Your Oneness
The supports of Your religion
The mines of Your generosity
Your chosen ones from Your creation
Your selected ones from Your creation
The pious, the pure
The noble, the righteous
And the gate through which people are tested
Whoever comes to it is saved
And whoever rejects it falls

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
The people of remembrance whom You commanded to be asked
And the relatives whom You commanded to be loved
And You made their rights obligatory

Arabic text: وَجَعَلْتَ الْجَنَّةَ مَعَادَ مَنِ اقْتَصَّ آثَارَهُمْ
Translation: And You made Paradise the destination for those who follow their footsteps

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
As they commanded obedience to You
And forbade disobedience to You
And guided Your servants to Your Oneness
O Allah, I ask You by the right of Muhammad
Your Prophet and Your chosen one
Your selected one and Your trustee
And Your Messenger to Your creation
And by the right of the Commander of the Faithful
The leader of religion
The guide of the resplendent ones
The faithful successor
The greatest truthful one
The distinguisher between truth and falsehood
The witness for You
The guide to You
The one who proclaimed Your command
The one who strived in Your path
Never deterred by any blame for Your sake

Arabic text: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: To send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
And to make me on this day

Arabic text: اَلَّذِيْ عَقَدْتَ فِيهِ لِوَلِيِّكَ الْعَهْدَ فِيْ أَعْنَاقِ خَلْقِكَ
Translation: In which You established the covenant for Your guardian upon the necks of Your creation
And You perfected for them the religion
Among those who recognize his sanctity
And acknowledge his virtue
Among those whom You have freed and released from the Fire
And do not let those who envy blessings rejoice at my misfortune
O Allah, as You made it Your greatest festival

Arabic text: وَسَمَّيْتَهُ فِيْ السَّمَاءِ يَوْمَ الْعَهْدِ الْمَعْهُودِ
Translation: And named it in the heavens as the Day of the Promised Covenant

Arabic text: وَفِيْ الْأَرْضِ يَوْمَ الْمِيثَاقِ الْمَأْخُوذِ وَالْجَمْعِ الْمَسْؤُولِ
Translation: And on earth as the Day of the Taken Pledge and the Questioned Gathering

Arabic text: صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: Send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
And comfort our eyes through it
And unite us through it
And do not let us go astray after You have guided us
And make us among those who are grateful for Your blessings
O Most Merciful of the merciful

Arabic text: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيْ عَرَّفَنَا فَضْلَ هٰذَا الْيَوْمِ
Translation: Praise be to Allah Who has made us recognize the virtue of this day
And made us see its sanctity
And honored us through it
And ennobled us with its recognition
And guided us with its light
O Messenger of Allah
O Commander of the Faithful
Upon both of you and upon your family
And upon those who love you, from me, the best of peace
As long as night and day remain

Arabic text: وَبِكُمَا أَتَوَجَّهُ إِلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّي وَرَبِّكُمَا
Translation: And through you both I turn to Allah, my Lord and your Lord
For the success of my requests
The fulfillment of my needs
And the easing of my affairs

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, I ask You by the right of Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: To send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: وَأَنْ تَلْعَنَ مَنْ جَحَدَ حَقَّ هٰذَا الْيَوْمِ
Translation: And to curse those who denied the right of this day
And rejected its sanctity
And turned away from Your path to extinguish Your light

Arabic text: فَأَبَى اللَّهُ إِلَّا أَنْ يُتِمَّ نُورَهُ
Translation: But Allah refused except to perfect His light

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ فَرِّجْ عَنْ أَهْلِ بَيْتِ مُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيِّكَ
Translation: O Allah, relieve the family of Muhammad, Your Prophet

Arabic text: وَاكْشِفْ عَنْهُمْ وَبِهِمْ عَنِ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ الْكُرُبَاتِ
Translation: And remove through them the distresses from the believers
O Allah, fill the earth through them with justice
As it has been filled with oppression and tyranny
And fulfill for them what You have promised them
Indeed, You do not break Your promise
